source: T. M. Mahim, A. S. M. Mohsin and M. M. Rahman, Phys. Rev. B 114, L291304 (2026); code and results archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21791358 (version 9: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23743716), file results/revised_mobilities.json, keys three_components/<mu_q_H>/'misfit lines + threading line charges' and pairs/<mu_q_H>/'misfit lines'. Values copied without change.
meaning: L_A_f1_per_cm is the in-plane line length per area (cm^-1) that the fit requires if each line carries f = 1 electron charge per in-plane lattice constant a = 0.3189 nm. The fit fixes only L_A f^2. relaxed_fraction_f1 = L_A b/(2 mismatch) with b = a (scripts/disorder_fit.py, relaxation_from_misfit, of that archive).
